status: Design only; no builder, model, fit or new source scan started
mechanism: Learn stop/start ordering, stand departure, inbound-versus-outbound motion and observation gaps from ordered raw positions; existing aggregate track inputs and six point-at-AOBT inputs do not preserve these sequences.

known_headroom.limitation: Descriptive reused CV error scope, not a gain forecast. The new identity-based two-point scope must be measured. Recording errors, especially no-AOBT rows, may remain physically unidentifiable.

frozen_candidate_data_spec.query_population: All supplied 2025 departures; fit still uses exactly the original ordinary-model rows. No departure target or recorded BLOCK field is read by the builder.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.identity: Reuse the audited aircraft_rotation identity.parquet exactly; unique near-takeoff aircraft only. Missing/ambiguous/conflicting identity yields no sequence. Shared input-only 120-second conflict cleanup is the existing root-approved policy.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.source: Existing data/external/adsblol_heatmap/positions daily cache, about1.665GB; retained observational snapshots around10s cadence, airport boxes +/-20km, ground or altitude<=10000ft.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.day_scope: Load previous/current/next UTC source files as needed. Event anchor is supplied takeoff, not hidden off-block. Keep raw altitude/ground state so preceding arrival motion remains distinguishable.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.selection: Same airport and audited aircraft; sort by timestamp. Deduplicate exact aircraft/airport/timestamp observations deterministically. Keep all histories with at least2 distinct timestamps; no32-point threshold and no complete-track requirement.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.dense_downsampling: Choose128 equally spaced chronological row indices including first and last. Preserve each selected point's true time and gap from its previous raw observation; do not interpolate across missing observations.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.storage: Ragged numeric point array plus per-movement start/count index; integer raw units preserve geometry/time precision. Six int32 point channels: takeoff-minus-position milliseconds, latitude microdegrees, longitude microdegrees, raw altitude code, deciknot ground speed, preceding-raw-point gap milliseconds.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.origin: Airport mean of cached X-Plane runway ends, matching existing stand_features origin. Per-point east/north offsets use that fixed origin; no label-based geometry.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.stand_and_runway_references: Supplied stand and departure runway, matched against existing stand_coords.parquet and runway_ends.parquet. Runway reference is the same paved runway end used by current features. Missing stand/runway coordinates receive explicit masks and zero numeric placeholders.
point_channels_after_transform: ground speed knots /100, with missing mask
altitude feet /10000, ground represented as0, with validity and ground masks
distance to supplied stand /20000, with known-stand mask
distance to supplied runway end /20000, with known-runway mask
asinh((point time-original AOBT3)/1800), with original-clock mask
frozen_candidate_data_spec.missingness: Right padding carries a separate point mask. Never impute points or replace missing original AOBT with schedule. Fewer than2 points forces residual branch output to exactly0. Missing speed/altitude/georeferences have explicit masks.
frozen_candidate_data_spec.fold_scope: All inputs are observation-only; the same frozen per-movement table can serve both outer folds. No target encoding or arrival-label context is introduced. Model rows, raw labels and train/held membership remain the audited baseline ones.

frozen_candidate_model_spec.tabular_branch: Original156-input N09 encoder/PLE/MLP and direct min(y,10800) target; unchanged optimizer, batch2048, 24-epoch OneCycle definition and final correction stack.
frozen_candidate_model_spec.sequence_encoder: Width32 temporal convolution;3 residual blocks,2 kernel3 convolutions per block, dilations1/4/16, SiLU and per-point channel normalization. No sequence dropout or batch normalization. Mask after convolutions and use masked mean+max pooling; all-missing max safely returns0.
frozen_candidate_model_spec.fusion: Concatenate original256-wide final tabular hidden state,64 pooled sequence values and quality masks; Linear128 -> SiLU -> Linear1. Last linear is all zeros. Add its output to the original standardized mean, gated by the >=2-point mask.
frozen_candidate_model_spec.initialization: Instantiate original N09 first using its exact seed; initialize extra modules inside torch.random.fork_rng and restore global state. Zero final fusion layer consumes no RNG. Require exact initial original tabular weights, eval/train mean predictions and dropout RNG equality against N09.
frozen_candidate_model_spec.training: Joint MSE on the original standardized clipped target; no auxiliary loss, sequence reconstruction loss, target-derived sampling or new class weighting. Trunk can change during training; only initialization and unavailable-branch residual are exact fallbacks.
frozen_candidate_model_spec.initial_screen: Seed42 k0, frozen parent full-fit epochs21 January/17 July, no inner replay. Compare matched N09 k0, exact size-matched half-control, full parent15, and fixed half-new/half-parent pool. No ensemble expansion before initial evidence.
frozen_candidate_model_spec.callsign_inputs: Do not silently combine the six new callsign features into this first architecture screen. A later combined candidate requires its own comparison if both mechanisms help.

availability_shift_checks: Report point/ground counts, duration, max gap and source censoring by airport/month, identity availability and original-AOBT presence; retain0/1/2-7/8-31/32+ cohorts.
Measure exact new >=2-point SSE scope using saved v58 errors after input-only features are frozen. Do not require32 points.
Explicitly compare 2025 and final2026 input coverage before deployment: 2026 summer source coverage is known to be much denser. No claim that availability masks alone solve this shift.
Report sparse versus dense and unavailable-sequence errors separately; a physical improvement cannot be inferred merely from aggregate RMSE on the covered subset.

builder_and_audit.algorithm: One UTC query day at a time; sort daily point groups by airport/hex/time, use searchsorted bounds per departure, immediately downsample and append the ragged result. Avoid a giant departure-by-position range join or loading the whole year into RAM.
builder_and_audit.input_hashes: Retain original query sources, audited identity, every position-day source, both coordinate maps, builder code, frozen settings, ragged arrays and movement index hashes.

resource_estimates.storage: Ragged int32 array requires24bytes per kept point plus index/masks. Absolute128-point upper bound about6.4GB for2.085M departures; actual likely lower and must be measured in a4-date pilot.
resource_estimates.GPU_strategy: Keep existing tabular tensors on GPU; gather padded sequence minibatches from a memory-mapped array, transform raw units to float32 on GPU, and use smaller inference chunks than the current65536-row tabular predictor. No simultaneous CPU heavy build and GPU fit.
resource_estimates.first_gate: Four-date source pilot plus one synthetic minibatch memory/runtime benchmark after explicit allocation; this measures scope/storage/runtime before a full build or fitted model.
